response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with strong systems, testing, and developer-tooling instincts, and even has rare direct IDE experience (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI) plus authorship of D-language dev tools (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts). However, the role's core requirements — deep JVM expertise, strong Java and Kotlin, and solid Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience — are essentially absent. Java appears only as a listed skill and in a brief 2016–2018 robotics/mobile-orchestration context; Kotlin and Spring never appear at all. The last decade has been overwhelmingly TypeScript/Node.js, D, and web/full-stack work. The gap between the required enterprise-JVM specialization and the candidate's actual stack is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise framework subsystems from day one.
strengths: Rare direct IDE development experience (LabWindows/CVI at National Instruments)
Built and maintained developer tooling: test runners, assertion libs, CI/CD infra
Strong low-latency/high-scale systems work and 15+ years of broad polyglot depth
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate experience
Java exposure is minimal and roughly a decade out of date
Recent career trajectory is TypeScript/Node full-stack, not JVM tooling
